title: Fix the Lambda Capturing a Reassigned Variable
description: The program should build a lambda that captures a loop-computed message.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print whichever value message held at the time the lambda captured it.
actualProblem: message is reassigned after the lambda is created, so it is not 'effectively final'. Java requires any local variable captured by a lambda to never change after its first assignment, so this code fails to compile: 'local variables referenced from a lambda expression must be final or effectively final'.
explanation: Lambdas capture local variables by value at the point of capture, and Java enforces that such variables never change afterward (effectively final) to avoid confusing or inconsistent behavior. Reassigning a captured variable after the lambda is created is not allowed.
